item.title: MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026
item.description: Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has announced the MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 for a total of 7,500 vacancies in the Madhya Pradesh Police Department. Eligible male and female candidates can apply online from 22 September 2026 to 06 October 2026. The recruitment process includes important stages such as written examination, physical efficiency test, physical measurement test and document verification as prescribed in the official rulebook. Interested applicants should carefully review the educational qualification, age criteria, application fee, examination schedule and other recruitment conditions before submitting their application. Candidates can access the online application form, official notification and other important resources through the links provided below.

item.title: Farmer Registry | Kisan ID Apply Online
item.description: Farmer ID भारत सरकार की डिजिटल एग्रीकल्चर मिशन (AgriStack) के अंतर्गत जारी की जाने वाली एक यूनिक डिजिटल पहचान है। इसका उद्देश्य किसानों का सत्यापित डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड तैयार करना तथा उन्हें सरकारी योजनाओं, कृषि सब्सिडी, किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड (KCC), फसल बीमा और अन्य कृषि सेवाओं का लाभ आसानी से उपलब्ध कराना है। Farmer ID आधार एवं भूमि रिकॉर्ड से जुड़ी होती है और इसका पंजीकरण राज्य सरकारों के माध्यम से चरणबद्ध तरीके से किया जा रहा है।

item.title: NVS Class 9th Admission Online Form 2027-28
item.description: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti has released the notification for Class 9th Lateral Entry Selection Test 2027-28 for admission against vacant seats in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas. Online applications can be submitted from 02/09/2026 to 30/09/2026, and the Selection Test will be conducted on 10/04/2027. Candidates must be bona fide residents of the concerned district, studying Class VIII in the 2026-27 academic session in a Government/Government-recognized school of the same district, with a date of birth between 01/05/2012 and 31/07/2014. The test will consist of 100 objective questions for 100 marks from English, Hindi, Mathematics and General Science, with a duration of 2½ hours and no negative marking. The application process is free of cost, and final admission will be subject to document verification and availability of seats.

item.title: MP SI Subedar Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 507 Posts, Check Eligibility & Exam Date
item.description: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has invited online applications for 507 posts of Subedar and Sub Inspector (DEF, SAF, and Technical Branches) under the MP Police Department.
